big: Nifty Financial Services Ex-Bank is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

h: What is the Nifty Financial Services Ex-Bank?
lines: What does the Nifty Financial Services Ex-Bank track?

The Nifty Financial Services Ex-Bank Index which aims to track the performance of portfolio of stocks from the Financial Services sector other than Banks. It holds 30 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
